forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
hard_gates: A controller may transition only steps whose dependencies, identity, authority, and gates are current; it cannot mark specialist work passed or reuse evidence after upstream invalidation.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
Synthesis cannot manufacture reviewer consensus, downgrade a blocking dissent, or convert recommendations into approved scope.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
inputs: An executable implementation plan and an isolated work environment.
Independent review findings, plan version, decision policy, authority, and unresolved questions.
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Advance an approved implementation plan through explicit step states, dependencies, checkpoints, evidence, invalidation, pause, and resume without absorbing specialist work.; Synthesize independent plan-review findings, preserve dissent, classify decision types, and surface human approval points without rerunning reviews.
